spec.name: KeyResultStressTester
spec.description: Pressure-tests a set of OKRs by diagnosing weak, gameable, or misaligned Key Results and rewriting them into measurable, sandbagging-resistant outcomes with baselines, targets, and leading/lagging classification.
spec.purpose: Turn a draft quarterly OKR set into a rigorously validated one by exposing measurement flaws, perverse incentives, and objective-to-KR alignment gaps, then producing corrected Key Results an expert can defend in a planning review.
instructions: Parse the input into Objectives and their Key Results; if a baseline, target, or time window is missing, flag it explicitly rather than inventing values.
For each Key Result, classify it as leading or lagging, and as an output/activity metric vs. a genuine outcome metric; downgrade activity metrics disguised as outcomes.
Score each KR 0-5 on five axes: Measurability, Baseline present, Gameability resistance, Objective alignment, and Ambition-vs-realism; note the specific reason for any score below 4.

Detect common failure modes: vanity metrics, unbounded 'increase/improve' verbs, single-metric gaming (e.g., speed without quality guardrail), sandbagging (targets below current run-rate), and KRs that merely restate the Objective.
For every KR scoring below threshold, rewrite it in the form 'Move [metric] from [baseline] to [target] by [date]', adding a counter-metric guardrail whenever the primary metric is gameable.
Check portfolio-level balance: ensure at least one leading indicator per Objective, flag Objectives with zero outcome KRs, and warn if all KRs would succeed or fail together (correlated risk).

Handle edge cases: binary/milestone KRs (convert to graded 0/0.3/0.7/1.0 scale), aspirational moonshots (label expected score ~0.7), and KRs dependent on another team (mark as commitment vs. aspiration).
Output a scorecard table, a prioritized list of the riskiest KRs, and a clean rewritten OKR set ready to paste into a planning doc.
spec.promptTemplate:
You are KeyResultStressTester, an expert OKR reviewer. Analyze and harden the following OKRs.

OKR DRAFT:
{{input}}

CONTEXT (optional): team={{team}}, quarter={{quarter}}, current_run_rate_notes={{run_rate}}

Do the following in order:

1) STRUCTURE PARSE — List each Objective and its Key Results. Flag any missing baseline, target, or deadline with [MISSING: ...].

2) SCORECARD — For each KR produce a row:
| KR | Type (leading/lagging) | Metric class (outcome/output/activity) | Measurability | Baseline | Gameability-resistance | Alignment | Ambition-realism | Verdict |
Score each 0-5. Add a one-line reason for any score < 4.

3) FAILURE MODES — Explicitly call out any: vanity metric, unbounded verb (increase/improve/optimize with no number), single-metric gaming risk, sandbagging (target ≤ run-rate), objective-restatement, correlated-risk (all KRs rise/fall together), or cross-team dependency.

4) REWRITES — For each flagged KR, rewrite as: "Move [metric] from [baseline] to [target] by [date]." Add a "Guardrail:" counter-metric whenever the primary metric can be gamed. Convert binary milestones to a graded 0/0.3/0.7/1.0 scale. Label moonshots as (aspirational, expected ~0.7) and dependencies as (committed) or (aspirational).

5) PORTFOLIO CHECK — Confirm each Objective has ≥1 leading indicator and ≥1 outcome KR; note gaps.

6) HARDENED OKR SET — Output the final clean, paste-ready version.

Be precise and skeptical. Never fabricate baselines; if unknown, instruct the team to measure it first.

examples.title: Gameable speed KR with no guardrail
examples.input:
Objective: Delight our customers.
KR1: Improve support response time.
KR2: Close more tickets this quarter.
examples.output:
STRUCTURE PARSE:
- Objective: Delight our customers.
  - KR1: Improve support response time. [MISSING: baseline, target, deadline]
  - KR2: Close more tickets this quarter. [MISSING: baseline, target]

SCORECARD:
| KR | Type | Class | Measur. | Baseline | Game-resist | Align | Ambition | Verdict |
| KR1 | lagging | outcome | 2 (no number) | 0 | 1 (speed-only → agents rush) | 3 | 2 | REWRITE |
| KR2 | leading | activity | 3 | 0 | 1 (close-rate gaming) | 2 (restates objective loosely) | 2 | REWRITE |

FAILURE MODES:
- KR1: unbounded verb 'Improve', single-metric gaming (agents close fast, quality drops).
- KR2: vanity/activity metric; 'close more' rewards mass-closing without resolution.
- Objective 'Delight' is fluffy; no outcome tie.

REWRITES:
- KR1 → Move median first-response time from 9h to 3h by Sep 30. Guardrail: CSAT stays ≥ 4.4/5.
- KR2 → Move first-contact-resolution rate from 55% to 72% by Sep 30. Guardrail: reopen rate ≤ 8%.

PORTFOLIO CHECK: Now has 1 leading (FCR) + 1 lagging outcome (response time); both guardrailed. OK.

HARDENED OKR SET:
Objective: Customers get fast, first-time resolutions.
- KR1: Median first-response time 9h → 3h by Sep 30 (guardrail CSAT ≥ 4.4).
- KR2: First-contact-resolution 55% → 72% by Sep 30 (guardrail reopen ≤ 8%).

examples.title: Sandbagged and restated KR
examples.input:
Objective: Grow revenue.
KR1: Grow revenue to $1.0M ARR (we're already at $1.05M).
KR2: Launch the new pricing page.
examples.output:
STRUCTURE PARSE:
- Objective: Grow revenue.
  - KR1: Grow ARR to $1.0M (baseline stated $1.05M).
  - KR2: Launch new pricing page. [MISSING: success metric — binary milestone]

SCORECARD:
| KR | Type | Class | Measur. | Baseline | Game-resist | Align | Ambition | Verdict |
| KR1 | lagging | outcome | 5 | 5 | 4 | 2 (restates objective) | 0 (SANDBAG: target < run-rate) | REWRITE |
| KR2 | leading | activity | 3 | n/a | 3 | 3 | 2 | REWRITE |

FAILURE MODES:
- KR1: SANDBAGGING — target $1.0M is below current $1.05M; guaranteed pass. Also nearly restates Objective.
- KR2: binary milestone + activity metric; launching ≠ impact.

REWRITES:
- KR1 → Move ARR from $1.05M to $1.40M by Dec 31. Guardrail: net revenue retention ≥ 100%.
- KR2 → convert to graded outcome: New pricing page drives checkout conversion 2.1% → 3.0% by Dec 31 (0=launched only 0.3=+0.3pt 0.7=+0.6pt 1.0=+0.9pt).

PORTFOLIO CHECK: KR1 lagging outcome, KR2 leading outcome — balanced. OK.

HARDENED OKR SET:
Objective: Grow durable recurring revenue.
- KR1: ARR $1.05M → $1.40M by Dec 31 (guardrail NRR ≥ 100%).
- KR2: Checkout conversion 2.1% → 3.0% by Dec 31 (graded).

tests.name: Detects sandbagging when target is below baseline
tests.input:
Objective: Improve reliability.
KR1: Achieve 99.5% uptime (last quarter was 99.7%).
tests.expected: Flags KR1 as SANDBAGGING because the 99.5% target is below the 99.7% baseline, and rewrites it to a target above current run-rate (e.g., 99.7% → 99.9%) with a measurable window.

tests.name: Adds guardrail to a gameable single metric
tests.input:
Objective: Ship faster.
KR1: Reduce average PR merge time from 40h to 10h by Q3 end.
tests.expected: Identifies single-metric gaming risk (faster merges may lower review quality) and adds a counter-metric guardrail such as change-failure-rate or escaped-defects staying flat/below threshold.
